not_selected_rationale: Unselected retrieved records remain auditable by ID/title in the query results. They were not carried into this bounded synthesis because they were clinical/non-strength topics, preprints/protocols, less-direct alternatives, or outside the purposively selected set; this is not a complete full-text exclusion assessment. ACSM 2009 was checked historically and is explicitly updated by S01.
known_limits: One bibliographic service, first-page result caps and language/access constraints can miss relevant studies.
Included syntheses share primary trials; their participants and effect estimates must not be added as independent replications.
No standalone post-cutoff citation index search or exhaustive publisher correction/retraction audit.
Source selection was performed by Codex; independent human verification remains pending.
